content.text: No non-compete, field-of-use, or exclusivity covenant binding Sparkling exists anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: (e) not use the Work except as authorized herein;
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on us. Section 3 (Restrictions on Use) is limited to ordinary licence-scope protections (no copying beyond backup, no sublicence/transfer, no reverse engineering, use only as authorized) and does not restrain what products we may buy, build or market. Section 2 grants a non-exclusive licence with no exclusivity or minimum-purchase commitment, and searches for "compet", "similar", "exclusiv" and "shall not develop" return nothing restraining our business. Section 19 is a mutual employee non-solicitation (one year, both parties), which is a personnel covenant rather than a business restriction and is addressed under the non-solicitation rule, not here. This meets the preferred position: no non-compete on Customer.
